name: io.github.avivgerz-hue/unslop
title: unslop — 7-Pillar Design Craft Engine
description: Audit UI design, extract Design DNA, generate tokens, and create transformation blueprints.

tools.name: unslop_audit
tools.description: Read-only static UI audit across 72 rules and 7 design craft pillars (Color & WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA + APCA Contrast, Typography, Layout, Surface, Copy, Motion, and Tokens) for JSX, TSX, HTML, Vue, Svelte, CSS, and Tailwind files. Use this tool first to baseline a project's Design Craft Score (0-100), inspect pillar-by-pillar breakdowns, and get exact file:line diagnostics with remediation guidance without modifying any files.

tools.name: unslop_list_presets
tools.description: Read-only catalog lookup for all 10 built-in studio design archetypes (such as 'linear-precision', 'anthropic-warm-editorial', 'swiss-grid-editorial', and 'vercel-mono'). Use this tool before calling unslop_apply_preset or unslop_refactor_plan to inspect available preset IDs, color polarities, typography pairings, surface tokens, and layout rules without modifying any files.

tools.name: unslop_extract_dna
tools.description: Read-only Design DNA extractor that parses a local CSS/stylesheet file or fetches a live HTTP(S) webpage URL to extract color palettes, font stacks, spacing scales, border radii, and shadow tokens. Compiles and returns a reusable DesignPreset object and Agent Skill markdown in memory without writing files to disk.

tools.name: unslop_apply_preset
tools.description: Install a built-in studio design preset across coding-agent ecosystems in the target project directory. Writes agent instruction rules, SKILL.md, design token files, and native MCP/plugin configuration files to disk, returning the list of created or updated file paths.

tools.name: unslop_refactor_plan
tools.description: Analyze a component or directory and generate a step-by-step Design Transformation Blueprint tailored to a studio preset. Writes a Markdown refactor report (default 'UNSLOP-REPORT.md') to disk and returns the 7-pillar scorecard, exact before/after class and token replacements, and prioritized file:line refactoring tasks.
